01.action: The hands hold their pose and barely breathe: the fingers curl and uncurl by a hair, the palms rise and sink a few millimetres with a slow inhale and exhale, tendons flex under the skin, and the stipple grain on the forearms shimmers softly like dust in a beam. The camera stays locked. The light stays fixed from above.
01.audio: Sound: a faint low room tone with the softest breath.

01.action: The hands slowly close into loose fists, drop a little and rotate palms-down as if letting go, hang for a beat, then turn back up, open finger by finger and settle into the exact cupped pose they started in. The motion is smooth and weighted, one continuous cycle. Locked camera, fixed overhead light.
01.audio: Sound: a soft rustle of skin, then stillness.

01.action: After a short hold the hands begin to withdraw: the left hand slides back toward the left edge, the right hand toward the right edge, palms still cupped, fingers relaxing as they go, and both dissolve into the black beyond the frame until only empty darkness remains. Locked camera, steady overhead light.
01.audio: Sound: a low hum that fades to silence.

01.action: The engraved dots that build the hands loosen and drift apart like ash lifted by a draft, the fingers thinning into scattered white specks that float up and outward, then the drift reverses, the specks stream back and stack into skin, knuckles and fingertips, and the two cupped hands stand whole again in their exact starting pose. Locked camera.
01.audio: Sound: dry grains hissing, then settling.

01.action: The camera pushes in slowly and steadily toward the space between the two palms, the hands growing larger in frame while they hold their offering pose, the fine dot grain and etched creases of the palms becoming crisp and large, until the fingertips almost reach the frame edges. The hands stay still. The light stays fixed from above.
01.audio: Sound: a deep quiet drone rising slightly.

01.action: The camera arcs slowly around the pair of hands, a gentle thirty-degree orbit from front to slightly above the left side, revealing the depth of the cupped palms, the hollow of each hand and the rounded backs of the fingers, while the hands hold perfectly still. Soft top light, black void all around.

A hard white key light travels from the left edge to the right edge of the frame: the left hand flares bright first, highlights sliding across its knuckles and fingertips, then the light crosses the black gap, the right hand ignites while the left sinks back into grey stipple, and finally the light returns to its starting position overhead. The hands hold still. Locked camera.
01.audio: Sound: a slow electric hum sliding in pitch.

01.action: The two hands drift toward each other and meet at the centre, joining into one large cupped bowl; a small pool of white light gathers in the joined palms, swelling into a soft glowing sphere with bright dot sparks lifting from its surface, and the hands lift the light slightly toward the camera and hold it. Locked camera, top light plus the glow from the sphere.
01.audio: Sound: a rising shimmer that settles into a warm hum.

01.action: The left hand rises and the right hand lowers, trading heights like the pans of a scale, then they swing back through level and swap again, a slow seesaw of weighing, before settling into their original heights with the left hand higher. Palms stay cupped and up throughout. Locked camera, steady top light.
01.audio: Sound: a faint creak of a balance beam.

01.action: The hands slide outward and downward toward the lower corners of the frame, palms still cupped and lifted, leaving the whole centre of the frame as clean empty black, then hold there as a quiet base for a title. Locked camera, steady overhead light, the forearms still dissolving into darkness.
01.audio: Sound: a soft low room tone.

02.action: The clasped hands hold still and breathe: the interlaced fingers tighten and loosen by a millimetre, the thumbs shift slightly on top, tendons ripple on the backs of the hands, and the stipple grain on the forearms flickers softly. The camera stays locked. Overhead light stays fixed.
02.audio: Sound: a faint room tone with a soft rub of skin.

02.action: The fingers slowly unlace and the two hands part, hanging open and relaxed from their wrists for a moment, then they swing back together, the fingers slide between each other one by one and lock into the same loose interlaced clasp they began with. One smooth continuous cycle. Locked camera, overhead light.
02.audio: Sound: a soft slide of fingers, then a light tap as they settle.

02.action: After a brief hold the hands separate and lift away along their forearms, the left hand rising toward the upper-left corner and the right hand toward the upper-right, fingers trailing loosely, until both slide out of the frame and only empty black remains. Locked camera, steady light.
02.audio: Sound: a low hum that fades to silence.

02.action: The engraved dots of the clasp loosen and scatter like blown ash, the interlaced fingers thinning into drifting white specks that spiral gently upward, then the drift reverses and the specks pour back together, rebuilding knuckles, tendons and the loose interlace until the clasp stands whole in its exact starting pose. Locked camera.
02.audio: Sound: dry grains hissing, then settling.

02.action: The camera pushes in slowly toward the knot of interlaced fingers at the lower centre, the crossing fingers and thumbs growing large and crisp, every etched crease and dot of grain becoming readable, while the hands hold their calm clasp. Fixed overhead light, black all around.

The camera swings slowly around the clasped hands in a low thirty-degree arc from front toward the right side, revealing the depth of the V of forearms and the layered crossing of the fingers, while the hands stay completely still. Overhead light, black void.

A hard white light passes from the top of the frame down across the hands: the knuckles flare, then the highlight rolls down the backs of the fingers into the interlace, the undersides glow briefly, and the light continues below and fades, returning the clasp to its original overhead lighting. The hands hold still. Locked camera.
02.audio: Sound: a slow electric hum sliding in pitch.

02.action: The clasp tightens, the knuckles whiten and the forearms tense as the hands squeeze hard; they tremble with effort, then the grip breaks and the hands fly apart to the sides, fingers spread wide and shaking out, and finally they come to rest open and relaxed below the centre of the frame. Locked camera, overhead light.
02.audio: Sound: a strained creak, a sharp release, then a soft exhale.

02.action: The two thumbs on top of the clasp begin to twiddle, circling around each other slowly, then the index fingers lift and tap together twice, then the hands re-settle into the same interlaced clasp with the thumbs at rest. Small, patient movements. Locked camera, overhead light.

The hands unlace and each forearm draws back toward its own upper corner, the hands coming to rest at the top-left and top-right of the frame with fingers hanging relaxed, leaving the whole centre and lower half of the frame as clean black for a title. Locked camera, overhead light.
02.audio: Sound: a soft low room tone.

03.action: The fists hold their pose and breathe: the pointing index fingers rise and dip by a hair, the curled fingers tighten and relax, the knuckles catch and lose small highlights, and the stipple grain on the wrists flickers gently. Locked camera, fixed frontal light.

Both index fingers slowly curl back into the fists, the two fists rotate a quarter turn to face knuckles forward and hold, then they rotate back and the index fingers extend again outward, left pointing left and right pointing right, landing in the exact starting pose. One smooth cycle. Locked camera, frontal light.
03.audio: Sound: a soft creak of knuckles.

03.action: After a short hold the two fists pull apart from each other and slide outward along their pointing directions, the left toward the left edge and the right toward the right, fingers still extended, and both exit the frame leaving only clean black. Locked camera, steady light.
03.audio: Sound: a low hum that fades to silence.

03.action: The engraved dots of both fists loosen and blow outward in opposite directions, the pointing fingers thinning into streams of white specks that trail left and right, then the streams reverse, the specks rush back to the centre and stack into knuckles, nails and fingers until the mirrored fists stand whole in their exact starting pose. Locked camera.
03.audio: Sound: grains hissing outward, then rushing back.

03.action: The camera pushes in slowly toward the seam where the two fists meet at the centre, the knuckle ridges and the folded thumbs growing large and crisp, the pointing fingers sliding out past the frame edges as the shot tightens. The fists hold still. Fixed frontal light.

The camera arcs slowly around the mirrored fists, a thirty-degree orbit from front toward the upper left, revealing the depth of the fists and the length of the pointing fingers in perspective, while the hands stay perfectly still. Frontal-top light, black void.

A hard white light sweeps from the left edge to the right: the left pointing finger flares first, the highlight rolls along it into the left fist, crosses the seam to the right fist and travels out along the right finger, then the light drifts back to its starting position overhead. The fists hold still. Locked camera.
03.audio: Sound: a slow electric hum sliding in pitch.

03.action: Both index fingers swing inward in one decisive move until they point at each other, tips almost touching at the centre; they hold the accusation for a beat, then both fingers swing up to point at the sky, and finally each curls back into its fist, leaving two closed fists back to back. Locked camera, frontal light.
03.audio: Sound: two quick whooshes and a soft knuckle tap.

03.action: The two fists twist against each other, rotating in opposite directions so the pointing fingers tilt, one up and one down, like the arms of a spinning sign, then they twist back through level and tilt the other way, and finally return to the horizontal mirrored pose. Locked camera, frontal light.
03.audio: Sound: a soft grind of skin on skin.

03.action: The fists slide apart along the horizontal axis and sink toward the lower corners of the frame, index fingers still pointing outward, and come to rest low at the bottom-left and bottom-right, leaving the centre of the frame as clean empty black for a title. Locked camera, frontal light.
03.audio: Sound: a soft low room tone.

04.action: Both OK signs hold and breathe: the rings tighten and relax by a hair, the fanned fingers sway gently as if in a faint draft, the fingernails catch tiny highlights, and the stipple grain on the wrists flickers. Locked camera, fixed hard front light.

The rings open as the thumbs and index fingers part, the hands relax into loose open palms and lower slightly, hang for a beat, then lift again and the thumb and index tips of each hand close into clean rings while the other fingers fan back up, returning exactly to the starting pose. One smooth cycle. Locked camera, front light.
04.audio: Sound: a soft tap as the fingertips meet.

04.action: After a short hold the two hands lower and slide away along their forearms, the left toward the bottom-left corner and the right toward the bottom-right, rings still formed, fingers trailing, until both drop out of the frame and only clean black remains. Locked camera, steady light.
04.audio: Sound: a low hum that fades to silence.

04.action: The engraved dots that form the hands loosen and float apart, the rings and fanned fingers thinning into drifting white specks that scatter across the black, then the drift reverses, the specks stream back and stack into knuckles, nails and rings until both OK signs stand whole in their exact starting pose. Locked camera.
04.audio: Sound: dry grains hissing, then settling.

04.action: The camera pushes in slowly toward the larger ring of the left hand, the circle of thumb and index finger growing until it fills most of the frame and the black inside it becomes a window, the etched creases of the fingers crisp and huge. The hands hold still. Fixed front light.
04.audio: Sound: a deep quiet drone rising slightly.

04.action: The camera arcs slowly around both hands, a thirty-degree orbit from front toward the right, revealing the depth of the fanned fingers and the round hollow of each ring in perspective, while the hands stay still. Hard front light, black void.

A hard white light travels from the upper-left corner down to the lower-right: the left hand's fanned fingers flare first, the highlight rolls around its ring, crosses the black gap, the right hand's ring and fingers ignite while the left sinks back into grey stipple, then the light drifts back to its starting position. Hands hold still. Locked camera.
04.audio: Sound: a slow electric hum sliding in pitch.

04.action: The left hand rises and brings its ring up to eye level like a monocle, a soft white glow blooming inside the circle; the right hand answers by snapping its fingers, the ring breaking into a snap with a spray of bright dots, then both hands settle back down into open relaxed palms. Locked camera, front light plus the glow.
04.audio: Sound: a soft chime swelling, then a crisp finger snap.

04.action: The two hands drift toward each other until the rings align on the same axis, one ring in front of the other like two lenses, hold the alignment for a beat, then drift back to their diagonal positions with the left high and the right low. Rings stay closed throughout. Locked camera, front light.
04.audio: Sound: a soft rising tone as the rings align.

04.action: The hands slide outward to the far left and far right edges of the frame, rings still formed and fingers still fanned, until each hand is half out of frame, leaving the whole centre as clean empty black for a title, and hold. Locked camera, front light.
04.audio: Sound: a soft low room tone.

05.action: The stacked hands hold and breathe: the flat palm presses and eases by a millimetre, the fist's knuckles tighten and relax, veins on the back of the upper hand ripple faintly, and the heavy stipple grain on both forearms shimmers. Locked camera, fixed top light.
05.audio: Sound: a faint room tone with a soft press of skin.

05.action: The open palm lifts off the fist and hovers a hand's width above it, the fist below opens slowly into a flat upturned palm, both hands pause, then the lower hand closes back into a fist and the upper hand descends and settles flat on top of it in the exact starting pose. One smooth cycle. Locked camera, top light.
05.audio: Sound: a soft slide of skin and a gentle pat.

05.action: After a brief hold the upper hand lifts and slides back toward the upper-right corner while the fist sinks and draws back toward the lower-left, both forearms retreating, until both hands leave the frame and only clean black remains. Locked camera, steady top light.
05.audio: Sound: a low hum that fades to silence.

05.action: The coarse engraved grain of both forearms loosens first, then the palm and the fist dissolve into a cloud of drifting white specks that swirl slowly around the point of contact, then the swirl tightens, the specks pour back into skin, knuckles and veins until the palm rests on the fist again exactly as it began. Locked camera.
05.audio: Sound: dry grains hissing, then settling.

05.action: The camera pushes in slowly toward the point where the palm meets the knuckles, the fingers of the upper hand and the ridge of the fist growing large and crisp, the etched veins and coarse dot grain filling the frame. The hands hold their pose. Fixed top light.

The camera arcs slowly around the stacked hands, a thirty-degree orbit from front toward the left, revealing the thickness of the fist, the flat plane of the upper hand and the length of both forearms in perspective, while the hands stay still. Top light, black void.

A hard white light passes from the upper right down to the lower left: the back of the flat hand flares first, the highlight slides down its fingers onto the knuckles of the fist, then rolls down the thick forearm and off the bottom edge, and the light drifts back to its starting position overhead. Hands hold still. Locked camera.
05.audio: Sound: a slow electric hum sliding in pitch.

05.action: The palm presses down hard and the fist resists, both forearms tensing; then the fist opens beneath the palm, the two hands turn toward each other and clasp into a firm handshake at the centre of the frame, shake once, and hold the grip. Locked camera, top light.
05.audio: Sound: a low creak of pressure, then a firm slap of a handshake.

05.action: The flat hand pats the fist twice, lifting and landing softly, then slides sideways off the fist so the fist rotates a quarter turn to show its thumb, then rotates back, and the palm returns and settles on top in the exact starting pose. Locked camera, top light.
05.audio: Sound: two soft pats and a faint rub of skin.

05.action: The two hands slide together toward the lower-left corner, the palm still resting on the fist, shrinking slightly as they retreat along the forearm, until the stacked pair sits small in the corner and the upper two-thirds of the frame is clean empty black for a title. Locked camera, top light.
05.audio: Sound: a soft low room tone.

06.action: The hands hold the string figure and breathe: the fingers flex by a hair so the white lines tremble and tighten, the crossing points glint, the diamond at the centre widens and narrows a millimetre, and the stipple grain on the wrists flickers. Locked camera, fixed top light.
06.audio: Sound: a faint room tone with the softest creak of string.

06.action: The hands draw slowly apart, the string pulling taut into simple parallel lines, then the fingers dip and hook through the loops and the hands come back together, the diagonals re-crossing and the central diamond re-forming until the exact starting figure is held again. One smooth cycle. Locked camera, top light.
06.audio: Sound: a soft creak of tightening string.

06.action: After a brief hold the hands drift down and apart along their forearms, the string slackening and sagging between them, and both hands sink out of the bottom of the frame taking the string with them until only clean black remains. Locked camera, steady light.
06.audio: Sound: a low hum that fades to silence.

06.action: The engraved dots of the hands loosen and drift apart while the white string stays floating in place, the fingers thinning into scattered white specks that hover around the figure, then the specks stream back and stack into fingers and knuckles that close around the string again until the hands stand whole in their exact starting pose. Locked camera.
06.audio: Sound: dry grains hissing, then settling.

06.action: The camera pushes in slowly toward the central diamond of the string figure, the crossing white lines growing thick and bright, the fingertips sliding toward the frame edges, the etched grain of the knuckles becoming large and crisp. The hands hold still. Fixed top light.

The camera arcs slowly around the pair of hands, a thirty-degree orbit from front toward the right, the string figure revealing its depth as the lines cross in space and the hands show their backs and edges, while the hands stay still. Top light, black void.

A hard white light sweeps from the left edge to the right: the left hand's fingertips flare, the highlight runs along the string lines across the figure making them glow, the right hand ignites while the left sinks back into grey stipple, then the light drifts back to its starting position overhead. Hands hold still. Locked camera.
06.audio: Sound: a slow electric hum sliding in pitch.

06.action: The fingers begin to move through the loops, the diagonals folding and the diamond collapsing as the string figure transforms step by step into a new pattern of a wide double X; the hands pull it taut and hold, then the string snaps at the centre and the two loose ends fall and swing from the fingers. Locked camera, top light.
06.audio: Sound: soft creaks of string, then a sharp snap.

06.action: The hands rotate together slowly around the vertical axis of the figure, the string figure turning like a wire sculpture so the diagonals cross in depth, a quarter turn one way and back through the start to a quarter turn the other way, then settle facing each other in the exact starting pose. Locked camera, top light.
06.audio: Sound: a faint creak of string under tension.

06.action: The hands slide apart and downward toward the lower corners, the string stretching between them into a long shallow V of white lines that hangs below the centre of the frame, leaving the upper half as clean empty black for a title, and hold. Locked camera, top light.
06.audio: Sound: a soft low room tone.
